verdict: Approved for the six assigned PDF images (printed pages 255–260). There is no clipping, overlap or column bleed. Hebrew (RTL) and English stay in separate columns, and every stanza pair is top-aligned. Running heads (חזרת התפלה) and page numbers alternate correctly between recto and verso, and printed numbers run 255–260 in order. The rule and the 'בשבת. / On the Sabbath.' heading sit correctly. The order of liturgical labels (חזן/קהל, ככתוב בתורתך / בדברי קדשך / על יד נביאך, ונאמר) is consistent across columns, and the text carries over correctly between pages (image 260 → 261 → 262). One caveat: the end of the batch (priestly-blessing introduction, source312 stopping point, missing-source label, retained credits) is not in the assigned images and still needs a separate check before the whole batch is signed off.
